paths.name: direct
paths.notes: guard lifts and rolls the blade back on top while rising to the high windup

paths.name: lift_then_roll
paths.notes: blade lifts sideways clear of the board first, then rolls on top and rises to the cocked-high windup

paths.name: hub_rise
paths.notes: blade lifts out of the right guard into the hub, rolls back on top and rises into the attack high windup
